text:
This document covers policies that apply across all venues managed by the
Meridian Events Group (Grand Meridian Conference Center, Willowbrook Garden
Pavilion, and Ironworks Loft), including rules specific to international
bookings.

For events with attendees traveling internationally, the events office
requires a finalized guest list 30 days in advance to process visa
invitation letters. International corporate bookings additionally require a
signed currency-hedging addendum if the contract is paid in a non-USD
currency, since venue pricing is quoted in USD.

Any venue booking may be postponed without cancellation penalty if a
force-majeure event (natural disaster, government travel restriction,
declared public health emergency) prevents the event from occurring. This
overrides the standard per-venue cancellation policy.

Clients booking more than one venue within the same calendar year receive a
5% discount on the second and subsequent bookings, applied to the base
rental fee only (not catering or AV add-ons).

All deposits are non-transferable between venues. Final balances are due 14
days before the event date across all three venues, regardless of each
venue's individual cancellation window.

The Grand Meridian Conference Center is a downtown venue located at 400 Harbor
Plaza. It offers five configurable event halls and is the flagship venue for
corporate conferences, product launches, and large weddings.

The Grand Ballroom holds up to 800 guests in theater-style seating or 450
guests banquet-style. The three breakout rooms each hold 60 guests
classroom-style. Maximum building occupancy including staff is 950.

Full-day rental of the Grand Ballroom is $12,000 on weekdays and $16,500 on
weekends. Breakout rooms rent separately at $1,200/day each. A 20% deposit is
required to hold a date.

Cancellations made more than 90 days before the event receive a full refund
minus a $500 administrative fee. Cancellations between 30 and 90 days receive
a 50% refund. Cancellations within 30 days of the event are non-refundable.
Date changes (not cancellations) are permitted once at no charge if requested
more than 45 days in advance.

In-house catering is mandatory for events over 200 guests. The venue offers
three tiers: Classic ($85/person), Premium ($140/person), and Executive
($210/person), all including a plated dinner and non-alcoholic beverages.
Outside catering is permitted only for events under 200 guests, subject to a
$1,500 outside-caterer fee.

Built-in AV includes a 20-foot LED screen, wireless microphones, and a house
sound system, included in the ballroom rental. Additional stage lighting
rigs rent for $600/day.

For events involving international attendees, the venue can arrange
multilingual signage and provides a currency-neutral payment desk. Visa
invitation letters for international guests can be requested through the
events office with 15 business days' notice.

Willowbrook Garden Pavilion is an outdoor-covered venue set in a botanical
garden, popular for weddings and smaller receptions. Located at 22 Willow
Lane, it has one primary pavilion and an adjoining lawn.

The pavilion seats 220 guests banquet-style or 300 standing. The adjoining
lawn can accommodate an additional 150 guests for cocktail-style overflow.
There is no indoor backup space, so a tent add-on is recommended for
rain-risk dates.

Pavilion rental is $6,800 for a 10-hour block. The rain-contingency tent
add-on is $2,200. A 25% deposit secures the booking.

Cancellations more than 120 days out receive a full refund minus a $300
processing fee. Cancellations between 60 and 120 days receive a 40% refund.
No refunds are issued inside 60 days. The rain-contingency tent fee is
non-refundable once the tent is reserved, regardless of notice period.

Willowbrook maintains a preferred-vendor list of five outside caterers; any
vendor from that list may be used at no additional fee. Caterers not on the
list require a $900 approval fee and a food-safety certificate on file two
weeks before the event.

Outdoor-rated sound system and two wireless lapel mics are included.
Additional uplighting for the garden path is available at $450/event.

Paved pathways connect parking to the pavilion; two accessible restrooms are
available on-site.

Ironworks Loft is a converted industrial warehouse at 88 Foundry Street,
favored for product launches, tech conferences, and corporate parties
wanting an exposed-brick, high-ceiling aesthetic.

The main loft floor holds 500 guests standing or 280 seated theater-style.
A mezzanine level adds seating for 80 more guests and is included in the
base rental.

Base rental is $9,500 for an 8-hour block, with a $750/hour overage fee.
A 15% deposit is due at signing, with the balance due 14 days before the
event.

Cancellations more than 60 days before the event forfeit only the deposit.
Cancellations within 60 days forfeit the deposit plus 25% of the remaining
balance. Cancellations within 14 days forfeit the full contracted amount.
Corporate clients with a signed master services agreement are eligible for
a one-time date-transfer waiver in lieu of cancellation fees.

No in-house catering; clients must use one of eight licensed caterers from
the building's approved list, each independently priced. A $400 kitchen-use
fee applies to any caterer using the on-site prep kitchen.

Full production package (line-array sound, moving-head lighting, 4K
projection) is available as an add-on for $3,200/day. Basic house sound and
lighting are included in the base rental.

Ironworks Loft does not provide visa support letters or multilingual
signage; clients hosting international attendees should arrange this
independently.
